theorem node_comparison_reciprocal (u i x y : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (hiu : i < u) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hi : padicValInt 2 t=i) (hc : x.testBit i=y.testBit i) : nodeComparisonRatio u x (rowResidue u x) y t m = nodeReciprocal u x y t m

theorem node_denominator_weighted (u i x y : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (hiu : i < u) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hi : padicValInt 2 t=i) (hc : x.testBit i=y.testBit i) : WeightedPolynomial (nodeDenominator u x y t m)

theorem node_denominator_reciprocal (u x y : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) : nodeReciprocal u x y t m = ((nodeDenominator u x y t m).eval (rowQuotient u x:ℚ))⁻¹
theorem node_denominator_row_class (u x y : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) : nodeDenominator u x y t m = nodeDenominator u (rowResidue u x) y t m

theorem actual_node_reciprocal_family (a u i x y : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (hx : x<2^a) (hy : y<2^a) (ht : (t:ℚ) ∈ grid a) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hi : padicValInt 2 t=i) (hiu : i<u) (hua : u≤a) (hc : x.testBit i=y.testBit i) : (chart a t (completed (grid a) u x y m)).coeff 1/diagonalJet a u i m = ((chart a t (completed (grid a) u (rowResidue u x) y m)).coeff 1/diagonalJet a u i m)* nodeReciprocal u x y t m

theorem actual_node_moment_error (a u i x y k : ℕ) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (hx : x<2^a) (hy : y<2^a) (ht : (t:ℚ) ∈ grid a) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hi : padicValInt 2 t=i) (hiu : i<u) (hua : u≤a) (hc : x.testBit i=y.testBit i) : VBound (k:ℤ) ((chart a t (completed (grid a) u x y m)).coeff 1/diagonalJet a u i m- ((chart a t (completed (grid a) u (rowResidue u x) y m)).coeff 1/diagonalJet a u i m)* (inverseTrunc (nodeDenominator u (rowResidue u x) y t m) k).eval (rowQuotient u x:ℚ))

theorem node_moment_right_integral (a u i k : ℕ) (hu : u≤a) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (ht : (t:ℚ) ∈ grid a) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hi : padicValInt 2 t=i) (hiu : i<u) (rb : MomentLabels u k) (y : Ports a) : VBound 0 (nodeMomentRight a u i k hu t m rb y)

theorem node_moment_product (a u i k : ℕ) (hu : u≤a) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (x y : Ports a) : (momentLeft a u k*nodeMomentRight a u i k hu t m) x y = nodeCrossingFirst a u i t m (OrientationRank.classPort a u hu ⟨rowResidue u x.val,row_bound u x.val⟩) y * (inverseTrunc (nodeDenominator u (rowResidue u x.val) y.val t m) k).eval (rowQuotient u x.val:ℚ)

theorem actual_node_moment_factorization (a u i k : ℕ) (hu : u≤a) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (ht : (t:ℚ) ∈ grid a) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hi : padicValInt 2 t=i) (hiu : i<u) (x y : Ports a) : VBound (k:ℤ) (nodeCrossingFirst a u i t m x y- (momentLeft a u k*nodeMomentRight a u i k hu t m) x y)

theorem node_moment_weighted_product (a u i k : ℕ) (hu : u≤a) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (x y : Ports a) : (momentWeightedLeft a u i k m*nodeMomentRight a u i k hu t m) x y = diagonalJet a u i m*(momentLeft a u k*nodeMomentRight a u i k hu t m) x y

theorem actual_node_weighted_moment_factorization (a u i k : ℕ) (hu : u≤a) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (ht : (t:ℚ) ∈ grid a) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hi : padicValInt 2 t=i) (hiu : i<u) (x y : Ports a) : VBound (jetWeight a u i m+k) (nodeActualFirst a u i t m x y- (momentWeightedLeft a u i k m*nodeMomentRight a u i k hu t m) x y)

theorem actual_node_moment_profile (a u i k : ℕ) (hu : u≤a) (t : ℤ) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (ht : (t:ℚ) ∈ grid a) (ht0 : t ≠ 0) (hi : padicValInt 2 t=i) (hiu : i<u) : (∀ (x : Ports a) (rb : MomentLabels u k), VBound (jetWeight a u i m+rb.2.val) (momentWeightedLeft a u i k m x rb)) ∧ (∀ (rb : MomentLabels u k) (y : Ports a),VBound 0 (nodeMomentRight a u i k hu t m rb y)) ∧ (∀ x y : Ports a,VBound (jetWeight a u i m+k) (nodeActualFirst a u i t m x y- (momentWeightedLeft a u i k m*nodeMomentRight a u i k hu t m) x y)) ∧ Fintype.card (MomentLabels u k)=2^u*k
theorem positive_anchor_moment_right_zero (a u i k : ℕ) (hu : u≤a) (m : ℕ → ℕ) (hiu : i<u) (hm : 0 < m i) (rb : MomentLabels u k) (y : Ports a) : nodeMomentRight a u i k hu ((2:ℤ)^i) m rb y=0

theorem geometric_inverse_identity (D : ℚ[X]) (k : ℕ) : D*geometricInverse D k=1-(1-D)^k
theorem geometric_inverse_integral (D : ℚ[X]) (k : ℕ) (hD : Content 1 (D-1)) : Content 0 (geometricInverse D k)
